mutant.original: `there is already a page called "${slug}" there`
mutant.lineText: if (siblings.has(slug)) throw new WikiError('exists', `there is already a page called "${slug}" there`);
mutant.nextText: if (siblings.size >= this.o.maxChildren) throw new WikiError('limit', `a page may have at most ${this.o.maxChildren} sub-pages`);
